calendar: HKEX securities market calendar — dates the exchange is CLOSED (gazetted HK general holidays falling on weekdays).
notes: HKEX securities market CLOSURE calendar, 2020-2026 — exactly the GovHK gazetted general holidays (General Holidays Ordinance) that fall on weekdays; HKEX trades Mon-Fri so weekend-falling holidays vanish (no substitution for Saturday-falling holidays since the 2006 five-day week — e.g. no closure for Jan 1 2022 or Oct 1 2022; no Monday substitute when 'first weekday after Christmas' itself lands on a Saturday, as 2020-12-26 and 2026-12-26). Sunday-falling holidays are substituted the following Monday, with collision handling: LNY extends to the fourth day (2021, 2023, 2024); Ching Ming colliding with Easter Monday adds the next Tuesday (2021-04-06, 2026-04-07); Christmas Day on Sunday promotes the second weekday after (2022-12-27). The Mid-Autumn closure is the day FOLLOWING the festival; 'day following' Ching Ming / Birthday of the Buddha / Chung Yeung entries appear when those fall on Sunday. Ad-hoc typhoon / black-rainstorm session suspensions (e.g. 2023-10-08 morning) are NOT holidays and are excluded. Source: GovHK gazetted general holidays per year (gov.hk/en/about/abouthk/holiday/<year>.htm), all seven years transcribed 2026-10-17. Maintenance: HK gazettes each year's list in the prior year's second half — extend then.
